text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While managing her poor physical 
condition, Manhattan Cafe managed to 
achieve an acceptable result.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While pondering what the next goal should 
be, Manhattan Cafe suggested she wanted to 
run in the "Yayoi Sho."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems her "Friend" wishes for her to 
run alongside Agnes Tachyon in this race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Delivering results here will pave the way 
to a GⅠ. Just as Manhattan Cafe proposed, 
the next race was set to be the Yayoi Sho.
